findings.text: follow-on: in the creating-verb branch the tail loop skips every token opening with '-', so an output-naming option carried in one token (for example --separate-git-dir=<path outside scratch>) is never resolved and a mutating init or clone could still name a git dir outside the scratch directory; the OS write fence and the PreToolUse guard still bound the write, so this narrows the branch's "entirely inside" claim rather than re-opening the run's worktree.

follow-on: the same branch resolves every non-flag tail token as a path beneath the invocation directory, so a clone whose source is outside the scratch directory (a remote URL or an absolute path) is refused even though clone only reads it, which leaves the module docstring's "a scratch clone" case unserved; this is over-refusal in the safe direction, not a hole.
